title: Navier Stokes Solver
description: Geometry attributes hold the fluid’s state; grid-neighbor sampling supplies the spatial relationships needed to evolve it. Each update computes velocity divergence, iterates a pressure solve, and feeds the pressure gradient back into velocity. Keeping those stages in sync lets the moving sphere stir a coherent flow while the pressure solve reduces divergence.
alt: A black-and-cream checker grid deforms as a theme-red toon-shaded sphere stirs the two-dimensional fluid.
